caption: The video captures a close-up of a curved, tapered drinking glass sitting on a dark, glossy surface against a very black background. The glass is filled with a golden-amber carbonated liquid, topped by a thin white foam head near the rim. A narrow, clear stream of liquid falls into the glass from the top edge of the frame, partially hidden behind the rim. The stream strikes the foam near the center, producing small ripples and subtle changes in the foam edge shape. Numerous tiny bubbles cling to the inner walls and float within the amber liquid, with some rising slowly. The density and distribution of these bubbles vary slightly from frame to frame as the pour disturbs the surface. The overall liquid level and the glass position remain essentially constant throughout the excerpt, showing no large rise or fall. Soft reddish reflections, a faint highlight streak on the left, and the bright base highlight stay stable, indicating little camera movement.
